name: Neck Roll
summary: A gentle cervical mobility drill moving the head in a controlled circular motion through flexion, lateral flexion, and extension.

setup: Sit or stand tall with an upright posture and relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin smoothly toward your chest to begin in cervical flexion.
steps: Slowly roll your head toward one shoulder, bringing the ear toward the shoulder without elevating it.
Continue the smooth circle by gently tilting your head back into mild extension.
Roll your head across to the opposite shoulder into lateral flexion.
Bring your chin back down toward the center of your chest to complete one full revolution.
Complete the target number of revolutions in one direction, then reverse and repeat.
instructions.breathing: Breathe continuously and evenly, avoiding holding your breath as the head circles.
cues: Draw large, smooth circles with the crown of your head

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the shoulders upward toward the ears
common_faults.correction: Keep your shoulder blades depressed and relaxed throughout the entire movement.

common_faults.fault: Moving rapidly or with jerking motions
common_faults.correction: Perform the circles in a slow, controlled cadence to safely mobilize the cervical spine.
Lengthen through the back of the neck and pass through extension gently without compressing the cervical joints.

precautions: Stop immediately if you experience dizziness, numbness, tingling, or sharp pain.
